sloka: रजन्यामप्रकाशश्च सन्तापयति चन्द्रमाः ।कृष्णरक्तान्तपर्यन्तो यथा लोकस्य सङ्क्षये ।। ६.४१.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: rajanyāmaprakāśaśca santāpayati candramāḥ ।kṛṣṇaraktāntaparyanto yathā lokasya saṅkṣaye ।। 6.41.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "Like at the time of universal dissolution, the moon is not radiant, being surrounded by black and red halo at night and is tormenting."
